sn21.5:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.5:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sujāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā.
sn21.5:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sujātaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn21.5:1.6: yañca abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
